## 02 – Log Analysis (owner: Tharindu)
Loki `query_range` for error/warning lines of the service around `started_at`.
Config: `LOKI_URL`, `LOKI_SERVICE_LABEL` (**confirm with Keshan**), `LOKI_LOOKBACK_MINUTES`, `LOKI_MAX_LINES`.

nodes.name: When called by 05 Root Cause
nodes.notes: Input: { incident_id, service_name, alert_name, severity, started_at }

nodes.name: Loki: query_range
nodes.notes: GET {LOKI_URL}/loki/api/v1/query_range (no auth for the local Loki).

nodes.name: Return skipped result
nodes.notes: Invalid input or source not configured: no HTTP call.
